howToApply: Check eligibility criteria carefully including educational qualification, age, and domicile/district requirements as per Annexure-1.
For NAPS trades: Register and apply through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme portal at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (available from 29.10.2026).

title: DVC Recruitment 2026 – Executive Trainee Posts
shortInfo: DVC has announced notification for Executive Trainee posts. Required qualification: B.Tech/B.E. Last date to apply: 06-12-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Payment of Application Fee

howToApply: Visit the DVC website www.dvc.gov.in and go to Career Section → Recruitment Notices.
Click on the ‘APPLY ONLINE’ link available on the website.
Step 1: Fill in all the particulars in the Online Application Form. After filling in the details, candidates can edit and update the data.

Step 2: Upload the photograph (3.5cm x 3.5cm, png/jpg/jpeg, max 2MB), signature, and other relevant documents/certificates (Class Xth/XIIth certificate or marksheet, essential qualification certificate, GATE scorecard, etc. in PDF, max 2MB).
Step 3: Preview the application form carefully.
Step 4: Submit the application. Once submitted, the application cannot be edited.
After submission, a Unique Application Number will be generated. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 300/- online (if applicable). SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM/Departmental candidates are exempted from fee payment.
Download the e-receipt after fee payment and retain it for future reference and submission at the time of Document Verification (DV).
A candidate can apply for one post/discipline only.

Submit the application. After final submission, details cannot be changed. Take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.

The application window is from 06.11.2026 to 05.12.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
